question: Find the area of a regular hexagon whose side measures 16√2 cm
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the regular hexagon (a) = 16√2 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of regular hexagon = (3√3)/(2)a²

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/accd168e6aafd57adf8e028dad481aff291ec3e6b58aa23cbcaba85fe7899ce3.png] **

Area = (3√3)/(2)(16√2)²

⇒ Area = (3√3)/(2)(256×2)

⇒ Area = (3√3)/(2)(512)

⇒ Area = (1536√3)/(2)

⇒ Area = 768√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
